item.title: I got fed up with Wispr Flow, so I built my own over a weekend
item.description: Why I built MurmurBee, a free, open-source Wispr Flow alternative that runs entirely on my Mac, and what it does - screen context, corrections, personal training, all offline.

item.title: How I built a private, personal Wispr Flow on my MacBook
item.description: The full story of building MurmurBee - the goal, my own Wispr data, picking the models, training on a MacBook Air, every experiment that worked and the ones that didn't.

item.title: Talking is three times faster than typing. Here's how to actually use that
item.description: Speech is about 3× faster than typing on a phone and well ahead of most people on a keyboard. What the research says, and how voice typing changed how I work.

item.title: How to dictate on a Mac like you talk - 7 habits that make voice typing work
